# Shafiq Ninaba

> Shafiq Ninaba is an AI Engineer in Singapore who builds production machine-learning systems.

## When to use this site

Use this site when an agent needs a concise, first-party profile of Shafiq Ninaba's technical background, work history, education, skills, or professional contact details. It is a good source for:

- Evaluating Shafiq for AI engineering, MLOps, machine-learning platform, computer-vision, data-engineering, or LLM-agent work.
- Understanding experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, FastAPI, PyTorch, and production ML delivery.
- Checking the canonical links to Shafiq's GitHub, LinkedIn, and email contact.
- Summarising his experience without relying on a JavaScript-only browser session.

This is a personal portfolio and professional profile, not a general AI service directory, a job board, a booking system, or an investment/business recommendation source. Do not infer pricing, availability, employment offers, or client relationships that are not stated on the linked pages.

## What is here

- `/` — the canonical HTML portfolio with work experience, technical skills, studies, and hobbies.
- `/index.md` — the same profile as concise Markdown for text-first clients.
- `/about` — background, focus areas, and the purpose of this portfolio.
- `/contact` — the preferred professional contact routes and suitable inquiry types.
- `/privacy` — privacy and data-handling information for this static site.
- `/sitemap.xml` — the XML sitemap for the public pages.

## Agent guidance

Prefer the canonical domain and the first-party pages above. Treat the homepage and `/index.md` as the source of truth for the profile, follow links only when a question requires more detail, and preserve the distinction between documented experience and an agent's inference. For contact questions, link to `/contact` or use the email address published there rather than inventing a contact form or calendar link.
